Locals don't post about this place. That's why the queue is all Vietnamese families.

Cơm chay tự chọn Bồ Đề Chay is a pick-your-own vegetarian rice spot on Đ. 30 Tháng 4. Under $10 a person. 4.7 stars from 246 reviews. You grab a tray, point at what you want, pay almost nothing.

No English menu pressure. No tourist markup. Just real local food.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
